breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly implements Strang splitting with exact Fourier-space diffusion half-steps and Rusanov finite-volume advection, matching the ground truth. While it mentions 'explicit forward Euler for the advection substep,' this is scoped specifically to describe the single-stage finite-volume update formula (u_new[j] = u[j] - (dt/dx)*(F_plus - F_minus)), which is the same formula in the ground truth. The diffusion steps remain exact in Fourier space. The conflict between a global 'Explicit forward Euler' time integration and Strang splitting is effectively resolved — the specification does not apply forward Euler to the entire system or to the diffusion steps.
